title: Quaternionic Elasticity Theory with Local Fractional Derivatives
summary: We develop a quaternionic formulation of linear elasticity in which the classical derivative is replaced by Yang's local fractional derivative and the classical Cauchy--Riemann operator by a fractal Cauchy--Riemann operator. We formulate fractal kinematics, a constitutive law with a material length scale and the equilibrium equation, and show that, for displacement fields with polynomial components, the resulting homogeneous fractal Lamé system is equivalent to the monogenicity of an explicit quaternionic field.
